hypotheses.title: Nested stage-5 resolvers (lambda/worker/loop bodies) forward package-wide accessors through the whole parentResolver chain, making narrowing lookups O(depth^2)
hypotheses.issue: In stage 5 each lambda body, named worker and loop body gets its own functionTypeResolver or loopTypeResolver, whose parent is the enclosing resolver. Almost every accessor in these resolvers just calls parentResolver.X() until it reaches packageTypeResolver: compilerContext(), unnarrowedSymbol(), getSymbol(), symbolName(), typeEnv(), lookupImportedSymbols(), packageID(), createNarrowedSymbol/createFunctionSymbol and the function-signature store accessors. None of them depend on the nesting level, but every call is a chain of O(depth) interface calls. The narrowing lookup (lookupBindingInner, isStableDeclaration, CaptureGroupContains in type_resolver_narrowing.go) calls compilerContext() and unnarrowedSymbol() several times for every capture entry on the chain. Each lambda pushes a capture entry, so a variable lookup at lambda depth D costs O(D entries x D forwards) = O(D^2), and every other context or symbol access in a deep body costs O(D). In a CPU profile of the D=400 reproducer, functionTypeResolver.unnarrowedSymbol takes 38% of flat time and functionTypeResolver.compilerContext takes 38%. The per-entry O(D) walk itself is a separately reported issue (2026-10-30-2); this one multiplies it by D.

hypotheses.fix_approach: Add a pkgResolver *packageTypeResolver field to functionTypeResolver and loopTypeResolver. Set it once at construction: p for function and field-init bodies, and packageResolver(t) for worker, lambda, inferred-lambda, while and foreach resolvers. Answer the pure pass-through accessors directly from it: typeEnv, getSymbol, unnarrowedSymbol, symbolName, createNarrowedSymbol, createFunctionSymbol, the function-signature accessors, compilerContext, lookupImportedSymbols and packageID. packageResolver() becomes O(1). Pitfall: some accessors must keep delegating to the parent because intermediate resolvers change their result: symbolType/setSymbolType (narrowing), ensureNotEmpty/ensureResolved, error reporting, mappingDefaults, objectMethodTable, traceSpan, opaqueContext, isEphemeral, scope methods, implicit imports, and the XML/mono counters. Check each one before short-circuiting it. make test passes. The remaining O(D) per-lookup capture-entry walk is the separate 2026-10-30-2 issue.
